title.narrative: Inner Mongolia Sustainable Cross-Border Development Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The investment program will promote sustainable development of cross-border areas and mutually beneficial regional cooperation and integration between the PRC’s Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region (IMAR) and Mongolia. The program will improve economic inclusion, ecosystems, and basic social services in the five IMAR border crossing point (BCP) communities and surrounding areas on both sides of the 3,200-kilometer (km) PRC–Mongolia frontier, which lags in economic and social development. Expanded financial and business support to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in border regions will spur local income growth. Establishment of an agricultural value chain will enhance livelihoods on both sides of the frontier. The program will have strong regional spillover benefits to Mongolia: improvement in infrastructure and services at IMAR–Mongolia BCPs will boost the volume and quality of trade, creating about 3,300 direct and indirect jobs in Mongolia; and improvement in health and other services will benefit disadvantaged communities on both sides of the border.

title.narrative: Contract awards for financial intermediation loans are not directly managed by ADB.
Contract awards for financial intermediation loans are not directly managed by ADB.
Loan 4012: 0% of contracts awarded and 0% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: The Project became effective on 31 March 2021 and was delegated to PRCM in 2022. Progress is accelerating with the project management consultant on board and procurement of civil works and equipment initiated and contracts awarded since 2022. As of Q4 2024, the cumulative contract awards totaled $45.9 million or 29% of the loan, and the cumulative disbursement totaled $27.7 million or 18% of the loan.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51192/51192-002-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Dec 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51192/51192-002-smr-en_4.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The smart port of Erenhot with one-stop inspection systems is being developed under Tranche 1. The civil works of infrastructures are ongoing with 70% progress and will be completed in Q3 2025. The smart management system is being procured with the contract award expected in Q3 2025.
The procurement of EG2-1-1 Erenhot Smart Port Management System Basic Facilities and Equipment was completed with a contract awarded in Q2 of 2023. All equipment in this contract package passed acceptance on 15 December 2023. Some equipment infrastructure has been installed. By 30 June 2024, the completed output value reached 90% of the contract price.
EG2-1-2 is being procured, and a contract award is expected in Q1 2025.
The protective forest in Erenhot-Zamyn Uud ECZ under Tranche 1 is under Contract ECW5-1: Greening project in the core area of the Erenhot Zamyn Ude Economic Cooperation Zone (Chinese region) which contract was awarded in August 2024. Construction is ongoing.
BOIM submitted its request to EA to withdraw from the project.
Training activities have been conducted under Tranche 1 since 2021 with the assistance of individual consultants engaged by EA and ADB and the project management consulting firm. As of December 2024, training on regional cooperation, project management, procurement, safeguards, financial management, and gender issues has been provided to about 340 government officials and staff of EA, IAs, and implementing enterprises, of which 41% are women.
